First public release of **VortexLabs Car HUD**, a free vehicle HUD for FiveM.

### Download
Attach: `vortexlabs_carhud-v1.0.0.zip`. Extract it into `resources/` and add `ensure vortexlabs_carhud` to `server.cfg`, after your framework, fuel and keys resources. The interface is already built; no Node.js or build step is needed.

### Highlights
- Bottom-right speedometer with gear and RPM, a nitro ring, side indicators, a throttle bar, and fuel and engine status.
- Location bar above the minimap (street, area, heading), anchored to the real minimap at any resolution and safe zone.
- Profiles for cars, motorcycles, boats, planes and helicopters. Never shown on foot or on bicycles.
- Seatbelt with crash ejection (frontal, rear, side and diagonal), lights and indicators, cruise control, engine start/stop with key checks, and server-validated nitro.
- Player menu `/carhud` and admin menu `/carhudadmin` (ACE permission `vortexlabs_carhud.admin`, validated on the server, saved without a database).
- Standalone, ESX, QBCore and Qbox. Fuel from ox_fuel, LegacyFuel, cdn-fuel or native, read only.
- English and Spanish (`locales/*.json`), English by default.
- VortexLabs design: black and charcoal, coral only for what needs attention.

### Tested so far
- Static checks and simulated tests (Lua logic, and the interface in a real browser).
- In game, on a Qbox + ox_fuel server.
- ESX, QBCore, LegacyFuel and cdn-fuel are supported through adapters tested in simulation, not yet on a live server.

Full details: [README](../../blob/main/README.md) · [CHANGELOG](../../blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

---

Primera versión pública de **VortexLabs Car HUD**, un HUD de vehículos gratuito para FiveM.

- **Instalación:** descomprime `vortexlabs_carhud-v1.0.0.zip` en `resources/` y añade `ensure vortexlabs_carhud` a `server.cfg`.
- **Incluye:**
  - velocímetro, nitro, intermitentes y estado de combustible y motor;
  - ubicación sobre el minimapa;
  - cinturón con expulsión, luces, crucero, motor con llaves y nitro validado por el servidor;
  - menús del jugador y de administración.
- **Compatibilidad:** standalone, ESX, QBCore y Qbox; combustible de ox_fuel, LegacyFuel, cdn-fuel o nativo; inglés y español.
- **Probado:** en el juego, en un servidor Qbox con ox_fuel. ESX, QBCore, LegacyFuel y cdn-fuel solo en simulación.

Detalles: [README.es.md](../../blob/main/README.es.md)
